svg.title: Stage 3 class diagram - Host, ComboMeal and Happy Hour (tag stage-3, final design)

g.text: Stage 3 class diagram - Host, ComboMeal and Happy Hour (tag stage-3, final design)
Customer's fields are private; state only changes
through seatAt / placeOrder / serve / pay / leave,
which check the current CustomerState first.
Staff.perform() enforces one task per turn and only
uses the task when the action succeeds.
The controller and Restaurant only hold Customer
chooseDish() and reactToService() are overridden by
VIPCustomer and CriticCustomer - no type checks.
every directed role; each subclass decides in
handle() which commands it accepts. A new role
is a new subclass registered in directedStaff.
Restaurant creates and owns its Tables;
GameController creates and owns the staff,
menu and restaurant of one game.
A ComboMeal is a MenuItem built from two
existing MenuItems: price = 90% of the sum,
units = sum, so Order, Chef and pricing
+showStatus(restaurant: Restaurant, turn: int, staff: List<Staff>): void
+showTurnEnd(restaurant: Restaurant, turn: int, maxTurns: int): void
#handle(command: StaffCommand, restaurant: Restaurant, turn: int): ActionResult
+cook(restaurant: Restaurant, orderId: int, turn: int): ActionResult
#handle(command: StaffCommand, restaurant: Restaurant, turn: int): ActionResult
+carryOut(command: StaffCommand, restaurant: Restaurant, turn: int): ActionResult
#handle(command: StaffCommand, restaurant: Restaurant, turn: int): ActionResult
#handle(command: StaffCommand, restaurant: Restaurant, turn: int): ActionResult
+takeOrder(restaurant: Restaurant, customerId: int, turn: int): ActionResult
+serve(restaurant: Restaurant, customerId: int, turn: int): ActionResult
+priceFor(customer: Customer, item: MenuItem, turn: int): int
Simple get...() accessors are omitted to keep the diagram readable.
